title: ReCiter AI Thresholds Configuration
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for config/thresholds.json. All operationally-tunable numbers for the ReciterAI pipeline. Added Phase 12 G-18 per D-23/D-26/D-27.

uncovered_score_floor.description: A publication's top topic score below this floor produces an UNCOVERED_PMID# event.

low_confidence_floor.description: Subtopic-assignment confidence below this floor produces a LOW_CONFIDENCE_ASSIGNMENT# event (event-emission threshold; distinct from confidence_floor per D-25).

drift_uncovered_rate_alert.description: When the uncovered-PMID rate in the drift window exceeds this fraction, the drift evaluator raises an alert.

drift_low_confidence_topic_max.description: When LOW_CONFIDENCE_ASSIGNMENT# counts under a single topic exceed this value within the drift window, it contributes to a recluster recommendation trigger.

drift_window_days.description: Rolling window in days over which drift evaluations are computed.

spotlight_dirty_subtopic_min.description: Minimum number of dirty subtopics required before a spotlight run is triggered.

spotlight_dirty_pubs_per_subtopic_min.description: Minimum number of dirty publications per subtopic required before that subtopic is included in a spotlight run.

tie_epsilon.description: Confidence values within this epsilon are considered tied when selecting the primary subtopic assignment (lifted from assign_subtopics.py:98 per G-18).

confidence_floor.description: Assignment-time floor: subtopics whose assignment confidence is below this value are excluded from a publication's subtopic_ids[] list. Distinct from low_confidence_floor (event-emission) per D-25. Lifted from assign_subtopics.py:95 DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR per G-18.

score_floor.description: Minimum relevance score for a publication to qualify as an activity row in assign_subtopics.py. Lifted from assign_subtopics.py:94 SCORE_FLOOR per G-18.

display_threshold_default.description: Global default for the topic-page display threshold (#69). SPS uses each topic's `display_threshold` (from `taxonomy_v2.json` / `hierarchy.json`) to render the topic page in two tiers; this value is the fallback applied to any topic that has not yet been individually tuned. Distinct from `score_floor` (which governs whether a paper is persisted at all). Per-topic values must be >= `score_floor`; tuning lives in `taxonomy_v2.json`.

feedback_sweep_max_pmids.description: Maximum number of UNCOVERED_PMID# rows the feedback sweep processes per run. When the cap is hit, the sweep emits truncated=true plus total_unprocessed_remaining per D-06.

recluster_persistence_days.description: Number of consecutive days LOW_CONFIDENCE_ASSIGNMENT# counts under a single topic must exceed drift_low_confidence_topic_max before a RECLUSTER_RECOMMENDATION# is written per D-07.

critic_reject_persistence_days.description: Rolling window in days over which CRITIC_REJECT# rows are aggregated per subtopic for the SPOTLIGHT_DIAGNOSTIC# trigger. 90 days covers approximately 3 monthly spotlight cycles per D-11.

critic_reject_subtopic_max.description: Maximum distinct (publish_id, pmid_set_hash) pairs within the critic_reject_persistence_days window before a SPOTLIGHT_DIAGNOSTIC# is written for that subtopic per D-11 (renamed from critic_reject_cwid_max per D-08 re-keying).

feedback_diagnostic_max_underlying.description: Maximum number of underlying CRITIC_REJECT# PK suffixes stored in a SPOTLIGHT_DIAGNOSTIC# row's underlying_rejects list per D-32.

bootstrap_lookback_days.description: Hot orchestrator cold-start window (days). When the prior-watermark resolver finds no STAGE# row for cold-orchestrator (first run on a fresh deployment), seed the watermark from now() minus this many days. Lifted from pipeline_hot/orchestrator.py:_BOOTSTRAP_LOOKBACK_DAYS per #57 Tier B-1.

discover_min_cluster_size.description: Minimum seed_pmids per cluster in discover_subtopics Pass 1. Clusters below this floor are dropped during validation. Lifted from discover_subtopics.py:MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE per #57 Tier B-1.

target_failure_rate.description: Score-publications stage target failure rate (per D-11). When the observed failure rate exceeds this fraction the stage prints a warning. Lifted from score_publications.py:TARGET_FAILURE_RATE per #57 Tier B-1.

pool_top_papers_per_subtopic.description: Spotlight pool ranker: pool_score is the sum of the top-N impact_scores per subtopic. Aggregation knob, distinct from output-shape knobs (SELECTION_SIZE etc., not yet lifted). Lifted from spotlight/pool_ranker.py:TOP_PAPERS_PER_SUBTOPIC per #57 Tier B-1.

retry_sweep_max_pmids.description: Maximum number of failed PMIDs the hot orchestrator's weekly retry sweep appends to the score set per run. Bounds the cost of a bad week; overflow candidates wait for the next sweep.

eligibility_sweep_enabled.description: Hot orchestrator (#150 1b): when true, the weekly run sweeps for enriched-but-unscored PMIDs (IMPACT#-with-synopsis minus scored/failed/quarantined/invalid) and folds them into the cache-respecting additive score set, self-healing the date-delta's post-synopsis gap. Set false to disable the sweep (e.g. during incident triage).

eligibility_sweep_max_pmids.description: Hot orchestrator (#150 1b): cap on the number of eligible PMIDs the weekly eligibility sweep adds per run. Directly bounds per-run Bedrock spend; a larger backlog drains over successive weekly runs (overflow waits). The scorer's onboarding cost guard does not apply to this --additive path, so this cap is the sole bound on the eligibility work set.

drift_sweep_enabled.description: Hot orchestrator (#150 item 2): when true, the weekly run re-scores publications whose synopsis was regenerated after scoring (IMPACT#.enriched_at advancing past the stamped scored_enriched_at, or a synopsis_model change). It demotes each drifted PROCESSING# checkpoint complete->stale so the cache-respecting --additive path re-scores it. Set false to disable the sweep.

drift_sweep_max_pmids.description: Hot orchestrator (#150 item 2): cap on the number of drifted PMIDs the weekly drift sweep re-scores per run. Bounds per-run Bedrock spend on a large re-enrichment event (e.g. a model upgrade); the overflow waits for the next run.

retry_sweep_quarantine_after.description: Number of failed scoring attempts (PROCESSING# retry_count) after which a PMID is quarantined — written to a QUARANTINE# row, excluded from future sweeps, and surfaced to the operator. Prevents infinite retry loops on un-fixable content.

retry_sweep_min_age_days.description: A failed PROCESSING# row must be at least this many days old before the retry sweep picks it up, so the normal pipeline has a chance to settle before a forced retry.

onboarding_cost_guard_max_pmids.description: New-researcher onboarding (#80): maximum net Bedrock/OpenAI-bound scoring work, in PMIDs, that a `score_publications.py --pmids` run will process without an explicit override. Counted AFTER per-PMID idempotency culling, so a near-complete re-run does not trip. Catches CWID collision / malformed queries / anomalously large publication histories.

onboarding_detector_cold_start_threshold.description: New-researcher onboarding detector (#106): when a daily detector run flags more CWIDs than this, per-CWID GitHub-issue filing is suppressed and a single digest issue is filed instead, so a cold-start backlog cannot flood the repo. Per-CWID filing resumes automatically once the flagged count drops back below this threshold.

spotlight_theme_similarity_max.description: Spotlight rotation selector near-clone gate (#91): two pooled subtopics whose short_description embeddings have a cosine similarity at or above this value are treated as near-clones, and the rotation selector will not place both in the same monthly publish. An embedding-cosine threshold, so it is data- and model-dependent — calibrate via `backfill_spotlight.py --dry-run` against the live pool (the dry-run prints the pool's near-clone neighborhood). Calibrated to 0.70 on 2026-05-19 against the live pool — every near-clone pair observed at or above 0.70 was a genuine duplicate. See spotlight/theme_dedup.py and config/thresholds.md.

enrichment_quarantine_threshold.description: Daily enrichment (#137): per-PMID consecutive-failure count at which the daily job writes the PMID off — the watermark is allowed to advance past it on the threshold-crossing tick, an ERROR Teams card alerts the operator, and the PMID is skipped on subsequent ticks until cleared via `scripts/run_daily_enrichment.py --retry-quarantine` or `--clear-quarantine PMID`. Distinct from `retry_sweep_quarantine_after` (scoring pipeline). State lives in DDB rows at PK `ENRICHMENT_QUARANTINE#pmid_{pmid}`.

spend_alert_increment_usd.description: Daily enrichment (#37): the dollar boundary between cumulative-spend alerts. Each time the calendar-year cumulative enrichment spend crosses another multiple of this value, the spend tracker posts one WARN Teams card — incremental budget visibility against the ~$400/yr ceiling instead of a single binary alarm. State lives in a DDB counter at PK `SPEND#daily_enrichment` / SK `YEAR#<yyyy>` (`pipeline_enrichment/spend_tracker.py`).

hierarchy_dedup_article_overlap_min.description: Cross-topic subtopic dedup (#164): two SYMMETRIC subtopics whose article-set overlap (min-cardinality coefficient |A∩B|/min(|A|,|B|), the D-23 metric) is at or above this value are merged. Reused from the within-topic aging-pilot gate (cli/aging_pilot_gate.py). One of two OR'd merge signals; see hierarchy_dedup_cosine_min.

hierarchy_dedup_cosine_min.description: Cross-topic subtopic dedup (#164): two SYMMETRIC subtopics whose short_description embeddings (Titan v2, via spotlight/theme_dedup.py) have cosine similarity at or above this value are merged. The second of two OR'd merge signals; see hierarchy_dedup_article_overlap_min. Data- and model-dependent.

hierarchy_dedup_containment_ratio.description: Cross-topic subtopic dedup (#164): a pair whose membership size ratio (larger/smaller) is at or above this value is treated as ASYMMETRIC containment — a finer subtopic nested in a broader one — and is NEVER merged (flagged parent/child instead), to preserve the granularity that the per-topic candidate-pool expansion adds.

hierarchy_dedup_flag_overlap_min.description: Cross-topic subtopic dedup (#164): an ASYMMETRIC (containment) pair whose article-set overlap is at or above this value is emitted as a parent/child FLAG for review (not merged).

spotlight_clone_overlap_min.description: Spotlight near-clone gate (#164): two pooled subtopics whose author-resolved article-set overlap (min-cardinality coefficient, D-23) is at or above this value are treated as near-clones and never co-featured in one spotlight publish. Complements spotlight_theme_similarity_max (description cosine) — the overlap signal catches equivalent subtopics worded too differently to trip the cosine gate (the spaceflight/disparities home-page duplicates). Containment pairs (size ratio >= hierarchy_dedup_containment_ratio) are exempt.

spotlight_theme_cap_patterns.description: Spotlight cross-cutting-theme cap (#164): EDITORIAL list of theme stems (case-insensitive substrings of subtopic ids) to feature at most once per publish. For cross-cutting themes (e.g. health 'disparit'ies) that recur across many parent topics as substantively-distinct facets — so neither the cosine nor the article-overlap signal flags them — but read as redundant cards on the home page. Each pattern's matching subtopics are connected into a near-clone clique so the selector keeps only the highest-scored one. Keep tight (it ignores descriptions/papers); a loose pattern collapses genuinely-distinct work that merely shares a word.

spotlight_scholar_penalty_lambda.description: Spotlight scholar-coverage downweight (docs/spotlight-scholar-coverage-selection.md): at the publish-N step, a candidate is docked by lambda * median_sel * (sum of its lead authors' current page-count) so one prolific lab cannot front several published cards. Marginal + escalating (a person's 2nd card is cheap, their 4th expensive) and SOFT — a top-tier card can still out-score the penalty and repeat a star. Scaled to the cleared set's median sel_score so the knob self-normalizes as scores drift. 0 disables it (pure sel_score truncation, the pre-policy behavior). Calibrated knee on the live pool: ~0.05-0.10 breaks a 4-card monopoly to 2 for ~2% page-quality cost; >=0.20 approaches zero-repeat.

spotlight_scholar_lead_depth.description: Spotlight scholar-coverage downweight: how many of a subtopic's top impact-ranked papers define its 'featured individuals' for spotlight_scholar_penalty_lambda — the first/last person_identifier of the top-N papers. 1 = only the headline paper's authors the lede names; 3 = the few papers the card actually fronts (recommended). Bounded by pool_top_papers_per_subtopic (7).

subtopic_reconcile_overlap_auto_match_mi.description: Durable-ID reconcile (#191 brick B), Stage 1: min-cardinality (Szymkiewicz–Simpson) seed-PMID overlap between a freshly re-clustered subtopic and a prior published subtopic at or above which the new cluster AUTO-ATTACHES to that prior durable id (no embedding/LLM stage). PROVISIONAL — to be sized by the forward-only Phase-1 jitter measurement; set above hierarchy_dedup_article_overlap_min (0.40) so an auto-attach is strictly stronger than 'distinct enough'.

subtopic_reconcile_overlap_ambiguous_min.description: Durable-ID reconcile (#191 brick B): floor of the ambiguous overlap band [ambiguous_min, auto_match_min). A new cluster whose best prior overlap lands in this band escalates to Stage 2 (label-embedding cosine) then Stage 3 (LLM arbiter); below it, Stage 1 contributes no candidate (likely genuinely new). Must be <= subtopic_reconcile_overlap_auto_match_min. PROVISIONAL pending the jitter measurement.

subtopic_reconcile_centroid_cosine_min.description: Durable-ID reconcile (#191 brick B), Stage 2: Titan-v2 label-embedding cosine at or above which an ambiguous-band cluster attaches to a prior subtopic on label similarity (else it escalates to the Stage-3 LLM arbiter). Reuses the proven hierarchy_dedup_cosine_min (0.75) vector space. PROVISIONAL pending the jitter measurement.

subtopic_reconcile_llm_arbiter_enabled.description: Durable-ID reconcile (#191 brick B), Stage 3 master switch. When true, clusters still ambiguous after Stages 1–2 are sent to the LLM arbiter (Bedrock Sonnet → OpenAI fallback); when false, they defer→mint, keeping the reconcile fully deterministic and offline (useful for the migration/shadow run before the LLM budget is sized).

subtopic_reconcile_merge_overlap_min.description: Durable-ID reconcile (#191 brick C): directional-containment bar (|prior ∩ successor| / |prior|) at or above which an unclaimed prior subtopic is recorded as merged_into the successor this run absorbed it into (a redirect); below it the prior is left untouched for brick F (demote/retire). Optional — when absent the reconcile uses subtopic_reconcile_overlap_auto_match_min, so a merge is at least as confident as an auto-attach. PROVISIONAL pending the jitter measurement.

propagate_durable_ids.description: Durable-ID propagation gate (#191 brick D3). When true, the three SPS-consumer surfaces additively stamp the durable subtopic id alongside the slug id: hierarchy.json SubtopicDef.durable_id, TOPIC# activity rows' primary_subtopic_durable_id, and spotlight.json spotlights[]/pool_snapshot[] durable_id. OFF by default — a gate-off run is byte-identical to today (the companion field is omitted entirely, never written as null). The durable id is resolved per surface by inverting the durable-ID store snapshot ({slug: durable_id}); unresolved slugs (a subtopic minted this run, one-run lag) omit the companion. Producers read this flag at process entry and pass it into the pure bundler/assembler. Flip to true only after SPS confirms it consumes the companion (see brick-d3 rollout).
